findings.message: scripts/smoke-build.ts now imports TEST_PLACEMENT_PATH, but startServer still hard-codes the env name as PIRATE_SEA_RACE_TEST_PLACEMENT: "1" (line 70) instead of using the protocol's TEST_PLACEMENT_ENV. The smoke check 'the production server offers no test placement' is only meaningful while the variable it sets is the one dev.ts reads. If TEST_PLACEMENT_ENV is renamed, the smoke test keeps setting a dead variable, still gets 404, and passes vacuously, so it would no longer prove that main.ts ignores the setting. The e2e config also repeats the literal, but drift there fails loudly (placements return 404). Import TEST_PLACEMENT_ENV alongside TEST_PLACEMENT_PATH.
